name: 书剑飘零官方教学版
english_name: Stray Book and Sword: Official Tutorial Edition
english_description: The official tutorial edition of Feibai Studio's Stray Book and Sword, built on the ES II engine family (adm/obj/master.lpc, "original from Lil, rewritten by Annihilator") and sharing its codebase with sibling title sjplii (Stray Book and Sword II). Despite also carrying the words "Book and Sword," it belongs to an entirely different engine lineage from the Century/adm-single family's sjecl and sje — a naming coincidence, nothing more.
